targets.rawSql: SELECT queue_depth FROM crawler_metrics WHERE queue_depth IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT coalesce(sum(active_slots),0) AS slots FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (worker) active_slots FROM crawler_metrics ORDER BY worker, ts DESC) s
SELECT coalesce(sum(processed),0) AS processed FROM crawler_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '24 hours'
SELECT coalesce(sum(failed)::float / nullif(sum(processed),0), 0) AS ratio FROM crawler_metrics WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
SELECT count(*) AS classified FROM domain WHERE last_checked_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT count(*) AS changes FROM changelog WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days'
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS time, sum(processed) AS processed, sum(failed) AS failed FROM crawler_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS time, avg(p50_ms) AS p50, max(p99_ms) AS p99 FROM crawler_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS time, max(queue_depth) AS queue_depth FROM crawler_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND queue_depth IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT classification::text, count(*) AS domains FROM domain WHERE last_checked_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT imported_at, list_id, line_count, imported_count, delisted, aborted, note FROM tranco_import ORDER BY imported_at DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Unbound queries (per 5m)
panels.description: Empty in dev unless the unbound-stats scraper runs (v6ctl ops unbound-stats; needs unbound remote-control).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS time, host AS metric, sum(num_queries) AS queries FROM unbound_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS time, host AS metric, sum(cache_hits)::float / nullif(sum(cache_hits) + sum(cache_miss), 0) AS hit_ratio FROM unbound_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroup(ts, '5m') AS time, sum(rcode_servfail) AS servfail, sum(rcode_nxdomain) AS nxdomain FROM unbound_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Global classification over time (daily stats)
panels.description: Populated by the daily stats snapshot (v6ctl stats recalc / daily tick).

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, heroes, saints, partial, sinners, inactive FROM stats_global_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Timescale background jobs
panels.description: Cagg refresh, compression, and retention jobs. A failed last run or growing total_failures silently breaks the stats pipeline — this is the panel that notices.

targets.rawSql: SELECT j.application_name AS job, coalesce(j.hypertable_name, '-') AS target, s.last_run_status, s.last_successful_finish, s.total_runs, s.total_failures FROM timescaledb_information.jobs j JOIN timescaledb_information.job_stats s USING (job_id) ORDER BY s.total_failures DESC, j.application_name

panels.title: Hypertable sizes
panels.description: Disk footprint per hypertable (data + indexes, post-compression). scan_detail should stay bounded by its short retention.

targets.rawSql: SELECT hypertable_name, hypertable_size(format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name)::regclass) AS size FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Database size
panels.description: Total on-disk size of the whynoipv6 database.
